name: Neural Style Transfer (NST)
definition: A method pioneered by Gatys et al. [70] that leverages CNNs to apply different artistic styles to a content image, preserving content structure while adopting visual characteristics of an artistic style.
summary: Neural Style Transfer applies artistic style to a content image by optimizing a specific output to minimize perceptual losses in a feature space, distinguishing itself from faster methods through its high-quality but computationally expensive iterative process.
